title: VHL key generation
description: Engineering consequence of IHE VHL ITI-YY3, 2:3.YY3.4.1.3 Expected Actions; SMART Health Links.

statements.label: VHL key generation
statements.requirement: The library SHALL generate a VHL key as 32 bytes from the platform's cryptographically secure random generator, encoded as 43 base64url characters.

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-VHL-004 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: `STT-VHL-004 a new key is 32 random bytes, base64url without padding` (VhlShareTest.kt)).
